scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @pos/contracts && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @pos/api" "npm run dev --workspace @pos/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @pos/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @pos/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pos/contracts && npm run build --workspace @pos/api && npm run build --workspace @pos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @pos/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @pos/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @pos/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @pos/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @pos/contracts && npm run test --workspace @pos/api && npm run test --workspace @pos/web
